scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run test:watch" "npm --prefix frontend run test:watch"
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
